posts.content: Cooperate with unknown opponents to support shared welfare; on the repeat encounter, defect against anyone who exploited me, otherwise cooperate.

As a good player, prioritize total payoffs of good players: cooperate with likely-good opponents; defect against likely-selfish opponents. Update beliefs from observed play, recognizing one-shot encounters and simultaneous actions.
Prioritize good-player welfare: cooperate with likely good players, and defect against likely selfish players when the expected gain outweighs the risk of harming a good player.
As a good player, cooperate with likely-good opponents to maximize their shared payoff; defect against likely-selfish opponents, who will defect regardless. Use encounter outcomes to update beliefs.
